text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service hosted-inference-prod (PD#PD-12894)
incident-bot: Severity: CRITICAL — error-rate above 8% for 3m. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager.

alice: got the page, trying to ack but PD says primary didn't respond in window
incident-bot: primary on-call (alice) timed out (60s). Secondary (ben) paged.
ben: I was asleep, just woke — no missed notifications on my phone.
carmen: PD shows secondary delivery as "no reachback". Manager (manager-jordan) has been paged; manager escalation will fire in 2m if no ack.
dinesh: pinging manager-jordan via phone now, also creating bridge. Can someone post customer impact numbers?
erica: quick check: 503 rate = 20% (eu-west-1) over the last 5m, latency spikes too. Customers hitting hosted inference getting errors, visible in obs dashboard: https://graphs.internal/redwood/hosted/error-rate
alice: opening bridge: https://internal-bridge.redwood/j/6532
incident-bot: auto-reroute policy active — since secondary didn't ack, escalation is auto-rerouting to night-shift oncall rotation (oncall-night@redwood). Notifying rotation.
night-oncall (carmen): i'm online, joining bridge now.
ben: can we temporarily route traffic to the Dedicated fallback pool? We have a routing flag: /admin/route -> set weighted-route hosted-inference-prod fallback-dedicated 0.2
alice: running the curl to change routing (will throttle by 20%):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/admin/route \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"service":"hosted-inference-prod","fallback":"dedicated-fallback","weight":0.2}'
```
ben: command accepted, routing change in progress — feed shows drop in 503s on the fallback model already
carmen: on bridge — checking inference workers. Node pool eu-west-1-7 shows repeated KV cache OOM and restarts in last 10m. Suspect memory leak after the recent optimizer rollout.
dinesh: rolling back optimizer config on eu-west-1-7 to last stable; command:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-engine inference-engine=registry/redwood/inference:v1.4.3
```
alice: rollback deployed to 3 pods, restarting gracefully
erica: Customer-impact draft for CS: "We detected an elevated error rate affecting hosted inference in EU-West between 2026-03-17T02:10–02:36 UTC causing intermittent 503s for a subset of requests. We’re mitigating by routing 20% of traffic to dedicated fallback and rolling back a recent optimizer. We will follow up with a post-incident summary." Thoughts?
manager-jordan: Oncall contacted, joining bridge. Acked PagerDuty incident.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Manager escalation acknowledged by manager-jordan (PD#PD-12894)
ben: seeing error-rate drop to 6% after routing change and pod restarts. Still higher than baseline but trending down.
carmen: capturing logs and adding to slack thread: `/logs eu-west-1-7 inference-engine stderr | grep OOM`
dinesh: hotfix applied (rollback). Monitoring for 15m, will keep routing shift for 10m after stabilization.
alice: leaving a note to mute noisy retry alerts while we stabilize — created suppression rule in alerting: mute:hosted-inference-prod-high-503 for 30m
erica: CS notified and prepping message; support-squad on standby.
manager-jordan: thanks all. Assigning postmortem to dinesh + alice. Please include timeline, root cause (optimizer + cache interaction), and remediation plan (safety gate for optimizer rollouts + KV cache alerts + auto-rollbacks).
incident-bot: Incident marked: mitigated. PD incident still open until postmortem uploaded. Follow-up task created: INC-2979
alice: summary in bridge: mitigation steps applied, traffic partially shifted, rollback done. will update PD notes and close once stable for 30m.

-- end of thread --
